rows.note: This is the all-purpose expression for saying that one quantity varies in direct ratio to another.

example.english: When cooking rice, the amount of water is proportional to the amount of rice.
example.traditional: 煮飯時，落水嘅分量同米嘅分量成正比。
example.jyutping: zyu2 faan6 si4 lok6 seoi2 ge3 fan6 loeng6 tung4 mai5 ge3 fan6 loeng6 sing4 zing3 bei2
